work_en: Three Refuges verses (三皈依)
notes: Liturgical refuge verses adapted from the Avataṃsaka Pure Conduct chapter (Buddhabhadra's 60-fascicle wording).

work_en: Sūtra of the Buddha's Bequeathed Teaching
notes: 佛遺教經, T389, Kumārajīva's translation; the Buddha's final admonitions before parinirvāṇa.

work_en: Sūtra on the Eight Realizations of Great Beings
notes: T779; translation ascribed to An Shigao (^1); Indic origin sometimes questioned.

work_en: Amitābha Sūtra (Smaller Sukhāvatīvyūha)
notes: T366, Kumārajīva's translation (^2), with appended note on the rebirth dhāraṇī (^28).

work_en: Platform Sūtra of the Sixth Patriarch
notes: Chan record of Huineng compiled by his disciple Fahai; Zongbao recension (T2008) chapter headings (^1).
metadata_issues: Category 'Discourses' misleads: a Chinese Chan patriarch's record, not buddhavacana.

work_en: Ten Short Mantras (十小咒)
notes: Chinese morning-liturgy set of ten dhāraṇīs (Cintāmaṇicakra, Cundī, Amitāyus, Bhaiṣajyaguru, rebirth mantra, etc.).

work_en: Sūtra in Forty-two Sections
notes: T784, ascribed to Kāśyapa Mātaṅga and Zhu Falan; preface on Emperor Ming's dream (^2); possibly compiled in China.

work_en: Sūtra of the Fundamental Vows of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva
notes: T412, translation ascribed to Śikṣānanda (^2); no Sanskrit or Tibetan parallel known.

work_en: Great Compassion Dhāraṇī
notes: Chinese transcription of the dhāraṇī from Bhagavaddharma's Thousand-armed Avalokiteśvara sūtra (T1060).
metadata_issues: Category 'Discourses' fits poorly: it is a dhāraṇī (similar texts are under Mantra or Liturgy).

work_en: Lotus Sūtra: Universal Gate chapter of Avalokiteśvara
notes: Chapter 25 of Kumārajīva's Lotus Sūtra (T262), including the verse section.

work_en: King of Aspiration Prayers: Samantabhadra's Good Conduct
notes: Chinese Bhadracarī verses with Tibetan-style Sanskrit/Tibetan title lines (^2–^3) and Mañjuśrī homage (^4).

work_en: Śūraṅgama Mantra
notes: Chinese transcription from the Śūraṅgama Sūtra (T945), opened by Ānanda's verse (^3); a Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī version.

work_en: Dhammapada (Chinese translation from Pāli)
notes: Modern Chinese rendering of the Pāli Dhammapada (423 verses, 26 vaggas), not the 3rd-century T210; translator unnamed.
metadata_issues: Title 法句經 is shared with the different T210 translation; no translator recorded.

work_en: Great Repentance before the Buddhas (Eighty-eight Buddhas)
notes: Chinese repentance liturgy: 88 Buddhas' names, 35-Buddha confession and Samantabhadra vow verses (^44–^45).

work_en: Vimalakīrti Sūtra
notes: T475, Kumārajīva's translation (^2).

work_en: Heart Sūtra (Xuanzang's Chinese version)
notes: T251, Xuanzang's translation (named in title); body has no title line.

work_en: Mengshan Food-Bestowal Rite
notes: Evening rite feeding hungry ghosts; traditionally compiled by Master Budong of Mengshan, later revised.

work_en: Medicine Buddha Sūtra
notes: T450, Xuanzang's translation (薄伽梵 wording); complete to the closing at ^54.

work_en: Avataṃsaka Sūtra: verses of Bodhisattva Forest of Awakening (覺林)
notes: Mind-as-painter verses from ch. 20 of Śikṣānanda's 80-fascicle Avataṃsaka (^1).

work_en: Pure Land dedication verse
notes: Chinese Pure Land dedication ending 同生極樂國 (^4).

work_en: Dedication verse from the Lotus Sūtra
notes: Verse from ch. 7 (Conjured City) of Kumārajīva's Lotus Sūtra, used as a dedication.

work_en: Sūtra of Recollecting the Three Jewels
notes: Chinese translation, likely from Tibetan, of the Ratnatrayānusmṛti; same work as aLXCGn9nHVFJR36gSvO5P.

work_en: Sūtra on the Eight Realizations of Great Beings (modern Chinese)
notes: Modern vernacular Chinese rendering with glosses of T779 (cf. bU8BjLKlQDfYkDDXYHjkn).

work_en: 84,000 Questions (八萬四千問)
notes: Modern question-and-answer introduction to Buddhism; apparently Dzongsar Khyentse Rinpoche's Chinese book of this title.
metadata_issues: Category misspelled 'Miscenaleous'; no author recorded for a modern authored book.

work_en: The Four Immeasurables
notes: Chinese of the standard Tibetan four-immeasurables verse (tshad med bzhi), 'mother sentient beings' wording.

work_en: Aspiration to uphold the Buddha's teaching
notes: Short aspiration to bear the Dharma's burden; source unidentified, probably Tibetan like its companion texts.

work_en: Ten Great Vows of Samantabhadra
notes: List of the ten vows from Prajñā's Avataṃsaka Samantabhadra chapter (cf. b3uHyHjYTGzzT0PNweKq0).

work_en: Dhammapada (Chinese translation by Bhikkhu 敬法)
notes: Modern Chinese translation of the Pāli Dhammapada (423 verses) by 敬法比丘, per title.

work_en: Refuge and bodhicitta verse
notes: Chinese of the sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog verse; popularly ascribed to Atiśa, ascription unverified.

work_en: Aspiration for bodhicitta
notes: Chinese of the Tibetan byang chub sems mchog rin po che verse; anonymous liturgical verse.

work_en: Dedication prayers
notes: Tibetan dedication set in Chinese: bsod nams 'di yis verse, two Bhadracarī verses (^6–^13), Vajradhara verse (^14–^17).
